policy_name: ScholarMaster Independent Three-Question Citation Decision Policy
core_principle: RESEARCH PLAN != PUBLICATION STATE != CITATION ELIGIBILITY != CITATION RELEVANCE != CITATION NECESSITY != ACTUAL CITATION

question_a_legal_chronology_eligibility.rule: Target paper status in {ACCEPTED_IN_PRESS, PUBLISHED} AND citing_date >= cited_date
question_a_legal_chronology_eligibility.invariant: Publication today does NOT retroactively legitimize historical forward citations.

question_b_scientific_relevance.rule: Explicit functional/methodological dependency in Research Plan Graph OR declared single-owner domain interface
question_b_scientific_relevance.anti_pattern_prohibited: paper.research_plan_position > target_paper.research_plan_position is STRICTLY PROHIBITED as a relevance rule.

question_c_citation_necessity_and_presen.rule: Actual manuscript inspection of .tex source determines whether reference exists or is scientifically needed.
